sections.title: Mental model
sections.body:
RxJS = **lazy push streams** with dozens of operators.

- **Observable** = lazy producer; `subscribe` starts the work.
- **Subject** = multicast; **BehaviorSubject** holds last value.
- **Operators** — `map` / `filter` (transform), `mergeMap` / `switchMap` / `concatMap` / `exhaustMap` (flatten), `combineLatest` / `forkJoin` (combine).
- **Schedulers** — when work runs (sync, async, animationFrame).
- **Hot vs cold** — cold per-subscriber, hot multicast.

sections.title: Must-know concepts
sections.body:
The interview surface for this module breaks into these focus areas:

- **Observables vs promises** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Operators map switchmap mergemap** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Subjects and behaviorsubjects** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Error handling in rxjs** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Multicasting and hot cold** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Schedulers** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Rxjs with http and forms** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Scenario-based** — applied questions tying multiple topics together. Drill these *last*, after the fundamentals are sharp.

sections.title: Likely interview hooks
sections.body:
- **`switchMap` cancels the previous** — perfect for type-ahead search.
- **`mergeMap` interleaves** — be careful with order.
- **`takeUntilDestroyed`** (16+) replaces the manual unsubscribe boilerplate.
- **`shareReplay(1)`** for cached values across subscribers.
- **`combineLatest` requires every source to emit** — common silent-bug source.

sections.title: Speaking template
sections.body: > *"I'd model the stream with `switchMap` for cancellation-aware fetches, `combineLatest` for joined state, share with `shareReplay`, and clean up via `takeUntilDestroyed` so I never leak subscriptions."*
